entries.description: Tachyon 4.6.0: a folder name no longer reaches a confirm dialog as HTML, and links in a message body keep only allowed schemes

A forward the target refuses no longer bounces to the original sender, who is forged in most spam (backscatter that listed a box at Spamhaus CSS); the bounce goes to devnull, and a forwarded bounce no longer freezes and is delivered twice. Aliases to local mailboxes keep the sender. Patched into a file the operator may have edited
